name: 100x-continuity
description: Builds your team a session-handoff plugin. Interviews you about your team and your storage, writes a plan you approve, then emits a tailored plugin into your own plugin repo — two plain-language skills your teammates use in Cowork to hand a Claude session over and pick one up. Handoffs go to a folder your cloud drive syncs, or to object storage behind an MCP server you run, so nothing here ever holds a credential. Install this to generate that plugin; it is not the plugin your teammates install.
